title: feat(research): improve doubled rank-seven packing
body:
## Summary

A finite packing improvement to PR3018, using a doubled `T=148` chronology and an 86-row journal that moves 50 helper roles. All exceptional `[4,8,9,9,9,9]@48` bins disappear.

```diff
- [0.0017290342130642563095108, 0.0017290342130642563095109]
+ [0.0017290353460708281979174, 0.0017290353460708281979175]
```

The certified gain is `1.1330065718884065e-9` to `1.1330065718884067e-9`, closing about 73.01% of PR3018's remaining fractional-packing gap. The exact complete delta is `4H1 + 4H3 - 4H5 - 2H14 + H32 < 0` for every `0 < b <= 1/100`. The new empty capacity-32 bin stays paid.

[Proof, journal, exact sources and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/553dc9d8fc8c1489aa2b0378331a0de4b5e9b44e/research/rank7-doubled-residual-exchange). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18979815).

This is a finite conditional moment improvement, **not a new admitted kappa**. Replica-dependent storage doubles; the finite physical namespace is 133,117, including all 91 private buffers. Full native/dirty restoration, physical backing/movement, precision, T-dependent constants, outer release and all-size/compiler admission remain unrun for T148. PR3021's complementary T74 restore/packing release does not bind these new artifacts. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Source PR2979 is pinned at `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`; PR3018 at `ca7113157d7c959fdfa9d7cd17ef92d3877070d0`. Base canonical main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Nick Petalas/PR3018, Mason Hale, Jeremy Kothe, Jeremy Diviney, Yiyang Lu, Tekalign, Ross Richardson/PR2987/3010, Dugongue, icekylinx, themilkman216 and the retained lineage. Assistance and review limits are recorded in TASK.json.

## Evidence

- **Before:** exact doubled PR3018 invoice, four exceptional bins, two paid H14 remainders.
- **After:** all 543,456 roles and 298,368 bins pass full source-window/family/mask/prefix checks. The retained owner engine agrees; a separate sorted-interval recount reproduces every idle rank and all twelve target patterns. One paid H32 replaces the two H14 remainders as part of the complete delta.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, nine rejecting controls, four behavioral groups, optimized CPython 3.12/3.14 execution, warning-as-error checks, Ruff and exact committed-byte verification all pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-doubled-residual-exchange`.

Next useful work is source-bound admission of this literal T148 order/fill, with every T-dependent physical constant rederived. No further search or integral-optimality claim is made.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One additive opt-in research package. No frozen source, shared checker, selected result or other PR disposition changes.
